reason: My customers call me, I keep the stock in my head and I order from the same two or three vendors. It's one more thing to learn and keep up every day, and the paper diary works for me.
objection: Nobody who orders from me types anything, they just call. If I have to record calls or forward things every day, that is extra work, not less.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked on its own from my phone calls without me doing anything extra, and the person who sets it up stayed with me until I was comfortable.
